description: Find ROP gadgets in a binary (ret-terminated). Returns up to max_results gadgets (default 1000) plus total_count and a truncated flag. The binary path must be inside an allowed directory (server cwd by default).

badbytes.description:
Reject gadgets whose final address contains these bytes
(e.g. "0a|0d" or "00-1f").

base.description:
Rebase the image base at load time (hex string, e.g. "0x400000";
"0" for RVA-style addresses).

binary_path.description: Path to the binary; must be inside an allowed directory.

offset.description: Offset added to gadget addresses after any rebase (hex string).

only.description: Keep only gadgets containing these instructions (e.g. "pop|ret").

section.description:
Executable section name(s) to scan; comma-separated, `*` globbing
(e.g. ".text" or ".init*,.plt").

description: Get binary metadata as JSON: format, arch, endianness, addr_size, image_base, entry, sections (name/vaddr/size/executable/writable) and PE imports. No scan is performed.

base.description: Rebase the image base before reporting addresses (hex string).

binary_path.description: Path to the binary; must be inside an allowed directory.

name: get_binary_info

description: Run a ROPgadget-style scan with explicit flags. args is a list like ["--depth", "6", "--only", "pop|ret"]. Allowlist: --depth --norop --nojop --nosys --only --filter --re --range --section --base --offset --badbytes --align --multibr --json; anything else (--string, --dump, --console, ...) is rejected. Output is always structured JSON.

args.description:
ROPgadget-style flags, e.g. ["--depth", "6", "--only", "pop|ret"].
Restricted to the allowlist: --depth --norop --nojop --nosys --only
--filter --re --range --section --base --offset --badbytes --align
--multibr --json. Anything else is rejected.

binary_path.description: Path to the binary; must be inside an allowed directory.

name: run_ropgadget_command

description: Search gadgets by pattern: regex matched against gadget text (e.g. "pop r.*; ret"); invalid regexes fall back to literal substring match. Runs a full ROP+JOP+SYS scan, then filters. Same caps as find_gadgets.

badbytes.description: Reject gadgets whose final address contains these bytes.

base.description: Rebase the image base at load time (hex string).

binary_path.description: Path to the binary; must be inside an allowed directory.

offset.description: Offset added to gadget addresses (hex string).

pattern.description:
Regex matched against gadget text (e.g. "pop r.*; ret"); if the
pattern is not a valid regex it is matched as a literal substring.

name: search_gadgets_by_pattern
